title: [Fabric] Exclude tables and fields for Fabric integration
summary: Added table and field validation logic to the Fabric integration to control which Business Central tables and fields can be mirrored to Microsoft Fabric.
key_points: Created FabricTableValidation codeunit with table exclusion logic
Created FabricFieldValidation codeunit with field filtering logic
Updated permission sets to include access to validation objects
Added comprehensive test coverage in TestFABPlatform codeunit
Expanded configuration validation without changing platform or table structures
